question: §6.2 sets Antigravity deep/fast to `gemini-pro-orchestrator-neon` / `gemini-4-hydrogen`, but nen copies those tiers into 15 persona `model:` lines. The host allows only inherit|flash|pro there. How should this PR land?

options.label: Hold deep/fast, land the rest ⭐
options.consequence: Frontier → gemini-4-carbon and all the registry, matrix, effort and docs changes land now. models.antigravity deep/fast stay pro/flash, so personas stay valid. The registry note and docs name the new lead slugs to type by hand, and a nen issue is drafted (not filed) for a separate persona key. The deep/fast slugs land when that issue does.

options.label: Apply §6.2 literally
options.consequence: models.antigravity takes all three slugs. The regenerated mirrors write gemini-pro-orchestrator-neon into 10 reviewer personas and gemini-4-hydrogen into 5 worker personas. Those values are outside the documented set, and whether Antigravity subagents still run on them is untested; testing needs an inference.

options.label: Stop and hand back
options.consequence: Commit nothing. I write up the conflict as the single open item for the spec's author and wait.
